text: The crowd moves before the beat lands.
A stranger hands you a little room near the rail without discussing it.
The chorus is coming. So is the urge to turn it into evidence.

choices.text: Keep the phone down and listen to the whole song.
Send the song to someone who would know why it matters.

text: You will not have a clip of the bridge.
Their reply arrives as the lights change.
For once, the timing feels made rather than optimized.
